About this Event

Embrace the introspective and grounding energy of the Beaver Moon with this evening virtual ritual.

Join us for a gentle yoga flow, guided breathwork, and a reflective journaling practice to help you release what feels complete and prepare for the transition into a quieter, more inward season.

This session offers space to gently let go of patterns, pressures, or expectations—while honoring what this chapter has taught you.

Whether you’re seeking closure, emotional release, or a mindful way to transition into the end of the year, this experience will support you in creating space for rest, renewal, and new beginnings ahead.

No yoga experience is needed; just bring a mat or blanket, a notebook, and your curiosity.

When: November 24 at 7:00 PM

Where: Virtual

During this 60-minute session, you’ll:

Move through a gentle, restorative yoga flow
Practice calming breathwork to release tension
Reflect, release, and create space for what’s next

Also check out other in Houston, Health & Wellness events in Houston.
